payload.title: Budget Council set the bill, and £313,000 of additions was put forward
payload.summary: Budget Council on 24 February 2026 passed the statutory resolution setting the city council's share of a Band D bill at £315.26, on a council tax requirement of £12,549,520 across 39,807 properties. Alongside it, Annex C set out £313,000 of extra spending from the Labour group, which the annex says forms part of the substantive motion rather than an amendment, and costed amendments from the Green and Liberal Democrat groups.
detail: The £313,000 covers fly-tipping and graffiti enforcement, communal-area improvements, community clean-up activity and political assistant provision, funded "in-year from the 2026-2027 budget contingency".

The other groups proposed a £65,000 ward-level community cohesion fund at £5,000 a ward, £45,000 for planting 100 trees at a stated officer price of £459 each, and £55,000 for river health education, signage and match funding.
The council has 39 councillors representing 13 wards. No minutes of this meeting are in this archive, so we cannot say who voted which way, or which of the amendments carried.
